productionTypes.name: Grain (field) corn
productionTypes.notes: The reference production type for every number in this profile unless stated.

productionTypes.name: Silage corn
productionTypes.notes: Grain hybrids or leafy hybrids at 2,000 to 4,000 more seeds per acre; rows under 30 in preferred in Wisconsin. Same staging.

productionTypes.name: Sweet corn
productionTypes.notes: Shorter, thinner leaves, tillers; fresh-market rows 30 to 40 in; processing populations about 56,000 to 90,000 plants/ha. Morphology entries are for grain corn and apply loosely.

productionTypes.name: Seed corn production
productionTypes.notes: Female:male row patterns (4:1, 6:2); male rows cut out after pollination leave an empty row every fifth to eighth row from August. Reads as a skip-row pattern.

regionsCovered.name: US Mid-Atlantic
regionsCovered.notes: Virginia is the app's testing assumption for every field (src/lib/weedCatalog/region.ts).

notes: The reference implementation of the Crop Intelligence Profile. US grain corn in 30 in rows is the most thoroughly sourced case; every other region and production type is represented with its own evidence where found, and with its gaps where not.
